definitions.short: to trumpet , i.e. blow on that instrument
definitions.full: H2690. chatsar or chatsotser [ חצצר ] verb Kt, [ חצר ] Qr, denominative from חצצרה = sound a clarion — Pi`el Participle מְחַצְּצ֯רִים 2Chr 5:13 (Qr מְחַצְּרִים ) = players on clarions . Hiph`il Participle מַחְצְצ֯רִים (Qr מַחְצְרִים as Hiph`il see Kö ii, 252 ) 1Chr 15:24 3 t. + 2Chr 5:12 Baer, (van d. H מחצררים ); sound with clarions בחצצרות ׳מח 1Chr 15:24 ; 2Chr 5:12 ; 13:14 ; absolute sounded (sounding) 7:6 ; 29:28 , compare חצצרה near the end (Kt in all to be pronounced (probably) מְחַצְצְרִים ). חֵק see חֵיק below חוק ; חֹק see below חקק .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; properly, to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form חֲצֹצֵר ; or (2 Chronicles 5:12) חֲצֹרֵר ; as dem. from 2689 ;
